gpui-component Root stores the open_dialog/open_alert_dialog builder as Fn and re-runs it each render. Callbacks and titles must be Clone (Rc for on_ok). Dialog does not auto-build a footer from button_props; AlertDialog.build_surface does. Prompt footer uses DialogFooter + DialogClose + DialogAction.

wezterm-gpui path-deps portable-pty and wezterm-term. Isolated workspace still compiles; wezterm-term inherits root workspace.dependencies by walking up. Did not pull wezterm-font/freetype. mux skipped (config/lua) at this slice. Screen::visible_lines is cfg(test) only; POC used for_each_phys_line sliding window of physical_rows.

wezterm-gpui path-deps mux + config + promise. Isolated cargo check green. Pulls lua/mlua/openssl/libssh (mux/ssh) but not wezterm-font/freetype. Mux PTY notify uses promise::spawn; POC runs SimpleExecutor on a side thread because GPUI owns GetMessage.

Even optional freetype-sys on wezterm-font/harfbuzz/gpui-freetype fails root cargo resolve: two links=freetype in one lockfile. Shim and HarfBuzz sys-freetype must not crate-depend on freetype-sys. wezterm-gpui depends on freetype-sys explicitly.
wezterm-font unix fontconfig vs GPUI yeslogic-fontconfig-sys both links=fontconfig. Feature native-fontconfig is default for wezterm-gui, off in wezterm-gpui.
